Question 2
?

Express 22x−38(3−x)(2−x)(x+1) as a sum of partial fractions.

a
−7(3−x)−5(2−x)+1(x+1)
b
1(3−x)+10(2−x)−2(x+1)
c
3(3−x)−4(2−x)+9(x+1)
d
−7(3−x)+2(2−x)−5(x+1)
e
5(3−x)+1(2−x)−6(x+1)
Submit
